components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Primary FAB
components.description: Circular ink tool for adding an event.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab-primary" type="button" aria-label="Add event today"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>

components.name: Secondary FAB

components.name: Field
components.description: Hairline lozenge for date, time, and repeat.
components.html: <label class="ds-field"><svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4"/></svg><input class="ds-field-input" type="date" value="2026-09-22" aria-label="Event date" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #dfdfdf; border-radius: 11px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; } .ds-field-input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: #111111; font: inherit; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: #111111; }

components.name: Title Input
components.description: Baseline event title. Not a box.
components.html: <input class="ds-title-input" type="text" placeholder="What’s happening?" aria-label="Event title" />
components.css: .ds-title-input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #dcdcdc; border-radius: 0; outline: none; padding: 4px 0 14px; font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: -0.035em; background: transparent; color: #111111; } .ds-title-input::placeholder { color: #b2b2b2; } .ds-title-input:focus { border-bottom-color: #111111; } .ds-title-input:focus-visible { outline: none; }

components.name: Event Line
components.description: Colored title plus optional time. No chip.
components.css: .ds-event-line { min-width: 0; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: baseline; line-height: 18px; text-align: left; color: #3e63dd; cursor: pointer; } .ds-event-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-event-time { flex: none; font-size: 12px; color: #8a8a8a; font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-event-line:hover .ds-event-title { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-event-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Today Mark
components.description: Filled ink disc on the current day number.
components.css: .ds-today-mark { min-width: 26px; height: 26px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: Hairline pill for a voice suggestion.
components.css: .ds-chip { flex: none; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #dedede; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #f6f6f6; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

narrative.overview:
Vertical looks like a private datebook opened to a list of days. The page is paper. The type is ink. There is almost no chrome. Month names, day numbers, and event titles do the work that other calendars give to grids, cards, and toolbars.

The system is quiet and typographic. Surfaces stay white. Actions are small, exact hardware: circular floating tools, hairline field capsules, and a sheet that rises only when a day needs an editor. Color on events is personal markup, not a brand skin. The one brand action color is Carbon Ink.

This record describes the incumbent calendar in `app/globals.css` and `components/vertical-calendar.tsx`. Future screens must stay inside this datebook. They must not become a week grid, a Google Calendar or Apple Calendar shell, a carded day list, or a colorful product UI.
keyCharacteristics: Paper field with Carbon Ink as the only brand action color
System SF-like type, tight tracking on titles, bold event names
Continuous day list: month columns on desktop, stacked months on mobile
Weekend days step inward; today is a filled ink disc
Flat surfaces; lift only on floating actions and sheets
Quiet hardware controls, not cards or chrome

rules.name: The Carbon Voice Rule
rules.body: Carbon Ink is the only brand action color. Signal Indigo may appear on one control or one thinking state per surface. It may not become a header, a selected-day wash, or a product skin.

rules.name: The Event-Is-Not-Brand Rule
rules.body: Event swatches color titles. They do not fill rows, cards, or the page.

rules.name: The Type-Is-The-UI Rule
rules.body: If a fact can be type on paper, do not put it in a card, badge, or colored block. Event titles stay bold ink. Times stay small gray numerals.

rules.name: The Day-List Rule
rules.body: Time is a vertical list of days. Do not introduce week rows, hour gutters, or a calendar grid.

rules.name: The Weekend Step Rule
rules.body: Weekends indent 24px. That step is the only layout ornament on the list.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on floating actions and sheets.

rules.name: The Hardware Rule
rules.body: Circles for tools. Hairline lozenges for fields. Sheets for editors. No cards around days.

dos: Do keep Gallery White paper and Carbon Ink as the brand action pair.
Do let type carry the calendar: tight month headlines, bold event titles, tabular times.
Do keep the weekend 24px indent and the today disc.
Do lift only floating tools and sheets. Keep the list flat.
Do treat controls as quiet hardware: circles, hairline lozenges, and a single ink confirm.
donts: Don't introduce a week grid, hour gutter, or Google Calendar / Apple Calendar chrome.
Don't wrap days in cards or paint rows with event color.
Don't turn Signal Indigo or event swatches into a product skin.
Don't add a second type family or decorative display face.
Don't add shadows to resting paper, rows, or headers.
